description: Document in Arabic script, possibly a commercial letter. Dating: 18th- or 19th- century based on the paleography. A potential Common Era year appears in the brief lines of text on the verso: fī [1]864 CE. The verso may comprise a letter address given that it ends with al-khawaja Ibrahīm. Needs examination.
